faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CGG PLSQL Developer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the CGG PLSQL Developer recruitment is 15 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the PLSQL Developer post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualifications for the PLSQL Developer post are B.tech, M.tech, or MCA. Candidates must possess one of these degrees to be eligible.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for CGG recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this CGG recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the job type for the PLSQL Developer position?
faq.answer: The job type for the PLSQL Developer position at the Centre for Good Governance (CGG) is Contractual.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CGG recruitment?
faq.answer: You can apply online for the CGG recruitment through the official website. The application process involves filling out the form, uploading documents, and submitting it before the last date.

faq.answer: The Centre for Good Governance (CGG) is located in Telangana. Specific city details are not provided in the extracted data.
